name: marp-kit
description: Starter kit for Marp decks: local preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX builds, and Netlify deploy
author: Nick Taylor

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npm run build:html && npm run build:pdf && npm run build:pptx && cp -R images dist/ && cp -R public/. dist/
scripts.build:pptx: marp slides.md --html --allow-local-files --pptx --output dist/slides.pptx && node scripts/strip-pptx-notes.cjs dist/slides.pptx
scripts.build:ci: CHROME_PATH=$(npm run --silent browser:install | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-) npm run build
